title: GEOTECHNICAL EARTHQUAKE ENGIN
description: Seismicity, earthquake intensity, propagation of seismic waves, design of earthquake motion, seismic site response analysis, in situ and laboratory evaluation of dynamic soil properties, seismic performance of underground structures, seismic performance of port and harbor facilities, evaluation and mitigation of soil liquefaction and its consequences. Seismic earth pressures, slopes stability, safety of dams and embankments, seismic code provisions and practice. To alternate with E4244.
raw_title_text: CIEN E4242 GEOTECHNICAL EARTHQUAKE ENGIN. 3.00 points .
